runtime.note: organisms: the husk holds apOI / apOC (om/<kind>/tick as the husk applies tick apOC then advances); objects: every display holds its own apOI / apOC (-1 = stopped), om/<object>/tick runs them

objectives.apOC: org clip clock (the tick applied at the next tick call)
objectives.apOI: org clip id (clips[].id; -1 = a stopped object display)

passenger.key: execute on passengers if entity @s[tag=rlk_ap_om_<display>] run data merge entity @s {..}
passenger.note: every model passenger also carries rlk_ap_om; culling off (width / height 0); om/face turns them to the husk yaw; om/<kind>/bars moves the rlk_hb_* bar to hp_bar_y (FN-29 fallback)

displays.name: crown
displays.note: the petal crown at the bag neck (scale 0 while a bell); the glow is painted emissive

displays.name: shield
displays.note: 3 cutout vesica panes 0.62 x 1.42 + a low-alpha bubble rim band + a yellow 3-leaf crown; only while shielded (om/basic/shield/on|off)

clips.name: org_spawn
clips.note: emergence pop 0.85 -> 1.06 -> 1 (the spawn scale-in)

clips.name: basic_bob
clips.note: two hop-slides: squash 0.92 / stretch 1.1, up 0.15

clips.name: basic_melee
clips.note: lean back 0-5, bump 0.4 forward, hit 10, settle

clips.name: basic_lie
clips.note: bell -> bag: tips forward 0-9, the bag model at 10 (cut), crown out

clips.name: basic_ranged
clips.note: bag: squash 0-3, crown glow 3, petals open 5-12, launch 12, recoil, close 14-20

clips.name: org_die
clips.note: dying look (the bag keeps its form), squash, shrink to nothing

displays.name: stalk
displays.note: S-curved dark-teal ribbon with pale rims, fronds, the gold shard

displays.name: cap
displays.note: cream hood-leaf; tilt = the hood lifted open

displays.name: orb
displays.note: pulse

displays.name: ring
displays.note: translucent cylinder r 1.3, h 0.5, only while immune (om/nurt/ring/on|off)

clips.name: nurt_idle
clips.note: stalk sway, the hood nods with a lag, the orb breathes

clips.name: nurt_buff
clips.note: the hood tilts toward the targets 0-8 and opens (tilt), the orb flares at 8

clips.name: nurt_die
clips.note: the orb bursts, the ring goes, the stalk droops and the hood falls, shrink to nothing

displays.name: orb
displays.note: bobs 0.6-0.8 above the tip

clips.name: guard_idle
clips.note: the orb bobs and turns; the spire sways a little

clips.name: guard_cast
clips.note: collapse 0-7, bud 7-16 (glowing slit), regrow 16-24, the orb flares at the shields

clips.name: guard_die
clips.note: shudder, the black wisp at 3 (red embers: kit), fades up

displays.name: cap
displays.note: cap + the orb eye (painted emissive)

clips.name: nest_fly
clips.note: wings flap V (up 28) <-> wide arch (down 14), the body bobs

clips.name: nest_cast
clips.note: the wings curl up into a vertical loop round the orb, the body rises

clips.name: nest_blink
clips.note: out 0-2 (the module moves the husk at 3), back in 3-6

clips.name: org_die
clips.note: the wings droop, it falls to the ground and shrinks

displays.name: face
displays.note: pulse scale

clips.name: destr_roll
clips.note: rolls on its side (face to the left), one turn per 32 t

clips.name: destr_fuse
clips.note: upright, face to the Heart; pulses every 9 t, every 4 t from 36

clips.name: destr_suck
clips.note: shrinks white-hot

clips.name: destr_blast
clips.note: flash; the split husk at 1 (the module then plays org_die)

clips.name: org_die
clips.note: the blackened split husk tumbles back to the ground and fades

displays.name: body
displays.note: fish = the leaf-shark hood; bud / pod / face are their own models (jaw and fin hidden)

displays.name: jaw
displays.note: the translucent bowl, sepals and the long front fin; hinge behind the middle

displays.name: fin
displays.note: the tail fin; yaw +-25 in pred_swim

clips.name: pred_swim
clips.note: tail fin yaw +-25, body +-8 with a 3 t lag, a slow bob

clips.name: pred_swallow
clips.note: rears 0-6, scoops 6-12 (eat), closes into the bud at 14

clips.name: pred_bud
clips.note: spins 45 degrees per loop (8-fold), bobs over the gold swirl; the core pulses

clips.name: pred_inflate
clips.note: the pod grows from the ground (its own model) over 8 t

clips.name: pred_burst
clips.note: the pod bursts (hit 0), the fish again at 2

clips.name: pred_bite
clips.note: jaw open 0-3 with the spikes flared, snap 4 (the module lunges the husk)

clips.name: pred_bite_chain
clips.note: 4 snaps 6 t apart (the module starts it 8 t before the first sector strike)

clips.name: org_die
clips.note: the core flashes out, the fish sinks to the ground nose first and shrinks

displays.name: heart_bulb
displays.note: translucent lemon seed 3.2 x 2.6 x 2.3, alpha ~0.86; the arrival egg = this model at scale 0.7, pitch 90 (upright)

displays.name: heart_cradle
displays.note: 5 knobbly root fingers + the mound; pedestal adds pale petal clumps + 3 gold sprouts

displays.name: heart_arms
displays.note: two root arms curling over the bulb to 4.0-4.3 b

displays.name: heart_tips
displays.note: leaf-flame sprouts, swaying

displays.name: vine_stem_0
displays.note: stretched along its length between the canopy rim and the hand

displays.name: vine_stem_1
displays.note: stretched along its length between the canopy rim and the hand

displays.name: vine_stem_2
displays.note: stretched along its length between the canopy rim and the hand

displays.name: vine_stem_3
displays.note: stretched along its length between the canopy rim and the hand

egg.note: upright (pose pitch 90 about x of the lying lemon); scales to 1 and pitches to lying over the landing (heart_drop 0-6)

clips.name: heart_hang
clips.note: the egg hangs in the canopy (hang canopy_y), swaying

clips.name: heart_up
clips.note: drawn up from the entrance height (9 b) into the canopy

clips.name: heart_lower
clips.note: lowered from the canopy to the lowered height, swaying 1-2 b and calming

clips.name: heart_drop
clips.note: released at 0, falls 0-5, lands 6 (pitches to lying, 0.7 -> 1, squash), settles; the hand rises away; the cradle full at 6

clips.name: heart_idle
clips.note: the bulb breathes 1.00 <-> 1.03, the sprouts sway

clips.name: heart_hit
clips.note: a flinch

clips.name: heart_gain
clips.note: a bright swell

clips.name: heart_wither
clips.note: the withered look at 0, sags and shrinks a little, the sprouts droop

clips.name: heart_blaze
clips.note: blazes (CS 0-24): bright look, swelling pulses

clips.name: heart_lift
clips.note: golden egg lifts out of the cradle (0-30) to hang cs_y, the vine hand comes down 20-40 and wraps at 40

clips.name: cradle_rise
clips.note: the cradle (pedestal look), arms and sprouts rise out of the ground

clips.name: cradle_sink
clips.note: back into the ground

entrance.note: E: the egg held by the vine hand at the entrance height, the cradle under the floor

canopy.note: phase 1 (and a reload in P1): hanging in the canopy

play.note: phase 2 (and a reload in T1 / P2): lying in the full cradle; the hand and the stems gone

footprint.centre: the arena centre (cx, cz) = theme POINTS["heart"]
footprint.note: bearings are compass degrees round the centre: 0 = north (-z), 90 = east (+x), 180 = south (+z); hang = the egg's lowest point above the floor

clips.name: dome_idle

clips.name: dome_pop

clips.name: wall_fade

displays.name: stalk_tip
